query_description: Monroe County, Indiana suicide deaths (ICD-10 intentional self-harm) by year
api_status: finder-stage parameter requirements blocked automated XML export (2026-06-13)
primary_source_citation: Indiana Department of Health. (2024). 2023 Indiana Overdose and Suicide Report. Appendix E Table E.1 — Suicide Deaths by County of Residence. https://www.in.gov/health/overdose-prevention/files/2023-Indiana-Overdose-and-Suicide-Report-_FINAL.pdf

notes: Raw file stored in CDC WONDER tab-delimited format. Counts are from IDOH-published NCHS vital statistics tables using the same death-certificate methodology as WONDER D77.
